name: Backyard Birds
description: The birds BirdNET-Go has heard today, illustrated with classic plates by Audubon, Gould, Lear and others, or AI paintings in six styles. Seven layouts, from a field log to a cluster of the day's birds. Colour, greyscale and black-and-white panels. Demo garden until set up.

settings.name: fal_api_key
settings.label: fal.ai API key (AI paintings, experimental)
settings.help: Only needed for the AI painting picture options. Each bird is painted once, from an openly licensed reference photo, in the background (it shows on a later refresh), and kept, at about US$0.04 a bird up to the daily limit below. Manage the paintings on this widget's page under Widgets. Get a key at https://fal.ai/dashboard/keys; it is only sent to fal.run.

settings.name: gen_daily_cap
settings.label: AI paintings per day
settings.help: The most new AI paintings (and cluster blends) made in a day, at about US$0.04 each. Paintings are kept, so a garden's birds only cost once; raise this to fill a new garden or a specimen sheet faster.

cell_options.name: url
cell_options.label: BirdNET-Go address
cell_options.help: Where BirdNET-Go's web page opens, for example http://birdnet.local:8080. Leave empty for a demo garden based on this cell's location.

cell_options.name: token
cell_options.label: BirdNET-Go API token
cell_options.help: Only if BirdNET-Go's Private Mode is on. Create one in BirdNET-Go under Settings, Security.

choices.label: Field log: today's birds as a list
Latest visitor: the bird just heard, and today's tally
Gallery: a card for each bird
Day chart: who called in which hour
Book plate: a page from a field guide
Full bleed: the latest bird's picture fills the cell
Cluster: today's busiest birds together in one picture

cell_options.name: caption
cell_options.label: Full bleed: caption style
cell_options.help: Only used by the full bleed layout. Folio, museum, figure and cyanotype are natural-history styles; stamp, woodblock, cameo and Art Nouveau frame the bird as a postage stamp, a Japanese print with a seal, an oval on a dark mat, and an arched poster. The serif and handwritten styles have fine strokes that suit colour and greyscale panels better than black and white ones.

cell_options.name: pictures
cell_options.label: Pictures
cell_options.help: Classic plates come from a reviewed pack of public-domain illustrations; birds without one get a photo toned to match. The AI options need a fal.ai key in the widget settings. In the cluster layout the AI options paint each bird and blend them into one picture; otherwise it shows their own pictures side by side.

choices.label: Classic plates, photos where there is none
Classic plates, AI paintings where there is none (experimental)

cell_options.name: photo_tone
cell_options.label: Photo colour
cell_options.help: With classic plates on, a photo standing in for a bird without a plate is toned sepia so the set matches. Lightly toned keeps most of the photo's colour with a warm cast; natural colour leaves photos as they are.

cell_options.name: art_style
cell_options.label: Art style (AI paintings)
cell_options.help: How AI paintings are painted. Each style keeps its own painting per bird, so switching back costs nothing. The engraving suits black and white panels.

cell_options.name: cluster_style
cell_options.label: Cluster: style
cell_options.help: Only used by the cluster layout with an AI option. The first five print each bird's own painting on one page, at no cost beyond the paintings: a specimen sheet named underneath, a numbered plate with a key, a wreath round a title, a field notebook with taped-in birds, or a specimen drawer with museum tags. Blended scene repaints up to six birds together with one more AI pass.

cell_options.name: cluster_size
cell_options.label: Cluster: how many birds
cell_options.help: Only used by the cluster layout: how many of today's busiest birds it shows. A blended scene takes at most 6.

cell_options.name: cluster_every
cell_options.label: Cluster: re-blend at most (blended scene)
cell_options.help: Only used by the cluster layout with an AI option. Each bird is painted on its own and kept; the paintings are then blended into one picture by one more AI pass (about US$0.04). When today's busiest birds change, the picture is blended again at most this often.

cell_options.name: panel
cell_options.label: Panel
cell_options.help: What the panel can show. Pictures are converted and contrast-stretched to match, the chart's heat scale snaps to the panel's steps, and on black and white the tones become patterns and the highlights become frames.

cell_options.name: chart_labels
cell_options.label: Chart labels (day chart, field log)
cell_options.help: Numbers on the day chart's cells and the field log's activity strip.

cell_options.name: min_confidence
cell_options.label: Minimum confidence
cell_options.help: Detections BirdNET is less sure of than this are left out.

cell_options.name: location
cell_options.label: Location (demo garden and clock)
cell_options.help: Picks the demo garden's birds and the time zone for times shown. Falls back to the app-level location.
